projects.title: Multithread Elevator Program (Java)
projects.description:
- Developed an elevator program in an object oriented language that simulated the behavior of 5 elevators running simultaneously to pick up and drop off individuals through the use of multithreading.
- Organized code into multiple classes and utilized the Array Lists data structure to provide the ideal time complexity to retrieve and add data between the threads and assured that no race conditions would happen.

projects.title: Random Food Generator at UCI
projects.description:
This webapp generates a random place to eat around UCI. 
To create this web application, I utilized:
- Google Maps Javascript API
- Google Places API Web Service
- HTML
- CSS
- Javascript
